exercises.name: Warm-up: easy walk in place, arm circles, leg swings
Circuit, 5 rounds of 40s on / 20s rest: squats, incline push-ups or wall push-ups, glute bridges, reverse lunges, plank, step jacks
Cool-down: hamstring, quad, hip flexor and shoulder stretches

permitted_adaptations.description: Swap every move for its low-impact version (no jumping, push-ups against a wall or bench)
permitted_adaptations.effect: Easier on joints for beginners; same moves, same time, same space

permitted_adaptations.description: Do 3 circuit rounds instead of 5 and shorten the cool-down to 4 minutes
permitted_adaptations.effect: Shortens the session by 15 minutes (12 from the circuit, 3 from the cool-down)

exercises.name: Warm-up: brisk walk, then easy jog
Intervals, 7 rounds: 1 min run at a hard but steady pace, 2 min walk
Steady easy jog or brisk walk
Cool-down walk and calf, hamstring and hip stretches

permitted_adaptations.description: Replace the running intervals with a stationary circuit (high knees, squats, step-ups, mountain climbers)
permitted_adaptations.effect: Removes the need for a running lane; needs open stationary space instead

permitted_adaptations.description: Run the intervals around a park loop path instead of a straight lane
permitted_adaptations.effect: Needs a loop path the whole group can share instead of a running lane

exercises.name: Warm-up: marching, arm circles, band pull-aparts
Strength, 3 sets of 12 each: band rows, band chest press, banded squats, banded glute bridges, band overhead press
Cool-down: mat stretches for back, hips and shoulders

permitted_adaptations.description: Do 2 sets of each move instead of 3
permitted_adaptations.effect: Shortens the session by 10 minutes; warm-up and cool-down stay the same

exercises.name: Warm-up on hands and knees: cat-cow, gentle neck and shoulder rolls
Sun salutations, 4 slow rounds (half salutations as the easier option)
Standing poses: warrior I and II, triangle, tree pose for balance
Floor poses: bridge, seated forward fold, lying twist

permitted_adaptations.description: Do 2 rounds of sun salutations, a shorter standing sequence and 3 minutes of rest
Skip the floor poses and rest standing; use a bench or tree for balance
permitted_adaptations.effect: No time on the ground; for wet grass or anyone who can't get down to the floor
